verdict.rationale: The evidence pack focuses on Gusto Embedded Payroll's API for partners (payroll processing, contractor payments, time off, webhooks) rather than on Gusto's own new-hire self-serve onboarding flow. No citation describes a self-serve flow that collects W-4, I-9, and bank details for a new hire before day one; the closest mention (gusto-docs-37) only refers to federal tax information configuration in the embedded API context, not I-9 or a self-serve onboarding checklist.
